query: I have a 54-year-old man with AMI. Among male patients 49–59 admitted for AMI with first troponin T >0.04 ng/mL, what are the median and IQR of initial values?
final_sql: SELECT (percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY value) - percentile_cont(0.25) within GROUP (ORDER BY value)) AS interquartile_range FROM labevents WHERE subject_id IN (SELECT subject_id FROM admissions WHERE gender = 'M' AND age BETWEEN 49 AND 59 AND admission_type_id = 17 AND first_troponin_t > 0.04);
